priors.question: Originalidad de homogamia de deseabilidad sin preferencia inicial por semejanza
priors.rationale: La proposición general ya está en teoría matching, Hitsch 2010 y, casi literalmente para apps, Topinkova/Diviak 2025; nueva aportación exigiría predicción más estrecha. La separación de navegación, primer mensaje y match se documentó explícitamente en Hitsch et al. (2010), antes del programa ESBM. No reivindicar originalidad general de la cadena. Rios–Saban–Zheng (online 2022) probó algoritmo con exposición e historial de matches en dos intervenciones de mercado; Rios–Torrico 2023 ya formaliza secuencialidad y direcciones del flujo. ESBM no reivindica novedad de optimización de exposición y reciprocidad ni de feedback por matches. External 2024 intervention already studies a causal micro-interaction influence independent of pre-exposure sorting. ESBM has not yet included an observed micro-behavior intervention; adding smiles alone would lack originality. ICONIP 2020 MotifGNN already models reciprocal recommendation over user directed interaction graphs with degree/motif structure. Our degree-conditioned reciprocity finding does not establish a new theory: it is a data-quality/control exercise on published dataset. Su & Hu 2019 already used ratios click/rec and msg/rec as popularity and modeled target and sender attributes and network centrality; 2020 MotifGNN already modeled mutual interaction graph. N82 smooth target CTR out-of-actor predictive advantage is not a new theoretical mechanism or 2/3. Contest researchers in 2011 already studied ranking profiles by expected click/msg, including RankSVM, Bayesian Regression Trees and simple popularity voting; source 2012 participant explicitly discusses click/rec and msg utilities. A generic target-click-rate advantage N82 is not novel and must be compared against original NDCG@10 or stronger actor-target/context models before any novelty claim. A prior 2023 thesis already performed time-to-breakup survival prediction on HCMST 2009 using Cox PH, Random Survival Forest and DeepHit and identified cohabitation, marriage, duration and meeting modality as predictors. New ESBM must supply unique causal or mechanistically discriminating prediction with superior properly heldout model, not just 'add duration/predict breakup' in HCMST source. Hypergamy review 2026-10-29: Existing evidence covers educational hypergamy trends, denominator effects, structural opportunity decomposition, and aspiration in messages for both sexes; ESBM cannot claim novelty of generic hypergamy, homogamy, aspirational hierarchy or exposure-vs-sorting mechanism. Licensed dyadic access gate: Graz 2021 has already tested perceived abilities vs objective performance in mate appeal; Joel et al. already find actor/partner variance partly predictable but relationship-specific attraction not from predate traits. ESBM must beat these strong baselines on truly new preregistered prediction, not repackage them. Tawkify 2025/26 gate: Eastwick et al. 2025 preregistered 4542 real blind dates find slight attraction to younger partners for both sexes; Moreno et al. 2026 use SAME Tawkify sample for modality and assert OSF data availability, not independent replication. Age gap in formed couples cannot be equated to women's older-partner attraction. Any age-hypergamy claim must beat this prior art and distinguish arranged-date selection.

priors.question: La red de perfiles mostrados es necesaria para separar preferencias de exposición
priors.rationale: Dos fuentes speed dating incluyen citas efectivas; fuente checa reporta intentos pero no perfiles vistos; sin no-interacciones observadas el denominador de riesgo se desconoce. El artículo Hitsch 2010 sí observó perfiles visitados antes de contacto; el archivo original de observaciones sigue inaccesible y se desconoce si el paquete E112322V1 las conserva; por ello la falta de denominador a nivel de nuestras muestras permanece. La oportunidad observada como conjuntos diarios de perfiles ofrecidos es medición practicable en plataformas reales pero su asignación es endógena a algoritmos y preferencias; condicionar por visita/no visitar no identifica el efecto de exposición per se. 8.36 million 'rec' records recovered in independent source with no verified definition of an actually seen candidate; excluding them exposes severe risks from equating graph relation with opportunity. Even if rec means recommendation, logged placement may differ from seen profile. SSJY train.txt 8,366,058 unique (actor,target,round) rec records and source generated_graph.py strips ROUND in derived relations.csv. Access opens opportunity-conditioned recorded candidate risk set, but actual attended/viewed impression and nonclick intention remain unobserved. 92.0% of unique click triples map to same-round rec. A candidate appears by recommendation in a page position with a photo; user can ignore or not attend, so rec includes opportunities presented/recorded rather than proven perceived impressions. Per-user ROUND order is sequential but lag between rounds depends on logins/navigation and is not a common calendar timestamp. Source 2012 warns nonclick rec can mean attention or distraction rather than conscious rejection. Hypergamy review 2026-10-29: Leesch et al. already decompose educational composition vs nonrandom marriage sorting, and Spanish regional correlations show educational assortative mating co-varies with inequality/mobility. This does not identify exposure, preferences or causal effect. Mixmosa gate: Physical in-person meeting is a more defensible actual encounter risk set than algorithmic rec; attendance and events tables exist, but opportunity assignment nonrandom and nonparticipating candidate universe not observed. Columbia mirrors are not new independent cohorts.

priors.question: Hay nuevas fuentes diádicas originales con datos descargados y suficiente temporalidad/exposiciones
priors.rationale: Columbia y Mixmosa tienen sí/no cruzados, pero Essex/eHarmony/OSF checo no procesados; ninguna satisface exposición completa + ex ante popularity. Los investigadores Rios sí dispusieron de exposiciones y decisiones diádicas históricas de una app real, pero fueron datos de industria no compartidos con nuestro proyecto. La disponibilidad de un instrumento publicado no equivale a acceso actual a filas. The original authors provide analysis code and a link to data at Archive.org, not a reachable CSV in our environment; sample has repeated encounters but does not measure app algorithm exposure or longitudinal relationship stability. Author-released original SSJY action graph is now physically inspected (SHA256 recorded) with 232954 click/msg events, 177413 distinct directed links, but has no documented candidate exposure denominator, no time or paired explicit rejection. 'rec' type may represent recommendation, yet its semantics and observer coverage are unverified. Event record includes actor, target, ordinal within-actor ROUND, rec/click/msg. Real rows processed with aggregate-only outputs. No explicit reject/no-like, verified reciprocal mutual like, absolute time or relationship duration. Not sufficient for original ESBM full multi-stage causal estimand. Although MotifGNN 2020 exposes SSJY through public Google Drive and N81/N82 were processed locally, original 2012 participant instructions restrict contest dataset to competition analysis/modeling and say scientific publication needs Shanghai Huaqianshu authorization. This is historical evidence, not a present formal license. Current rights unverified; no further research use or dissemination should proceed until rightsholder confirms. No original rows in GitHub. Hypergamy review 2026-10-29: Bruch-Newman message networks show aspirational contacts and replies; Urbina code is replicable with authorized IPUMS marriage samples but no dyadic exposures/rejections; original microdata not accessed. Mixmosa gate: Original operator Mixmosa repository provides actual attended eight-minute dyads and separate male/female yes/no outcomes, unlike SSJY recommendation; however data license not explicit, not confirmed duration, event selection and repeated participants; potential new independent source but NOT research ready. Licensed dyadic access gate: Independent original Graz dyadic and Joel 2005/2007 speed-dating datasets have explicit institutional scientific/end-user licences; both gated by authentication and terms, no bytes retrieved. This is a materially better rights route than Mixmosa unknown-license, but not currently research ready.

priors.question: Permutación global o nulo por evento simple bastan para atribuir homogamia a mecanismo individual
priors.rationale: Nulos competentes requieren preservar segmentos, oportunidades, propensión de ambos extremos; mezcla MCMC no demostrada, replicaciones con diferencias. For HCMST-2009, minimally competent model comparison is not naïve constant hazard: already published Cox/RSF/DeepHit. A truly strong baseline also needs landmark/interview-risk sets, relationship duration at baseline (delayed entry), interval-censoring, partner death as competing event, sampling/attrition weights, and external era holdout (HCMST 2017 with different wording) not just random within-wave 70/30 split. 2023 thesis published C-index differences RSF .795 vs Cox .791 too small to claim superiority without uncertainty. Text reports Brier scores in 2017 above 1, inconsistent with ordinary unscaled Brier definition; verify units before using comparisons, no accusation. The recovered Stata W6 binary's header describes 640 cases versus 4002 file records each in W4 and W5; a valid 2009-to-2017 survival baseline needs attrition/survival eligibility conditions and wave-specific recruitment, as well as full baseline original IDs, not the naive ratio 640/4002. W4/W5 have w4_status, w4_xqualified, w5_status, w5x_qualified and w4_broke_up/w5_broke_up, and W6 distinguishes spouse death and breakup. Only schema fields inspected, so neither denominator nor event rates are established. Existing 2023 Cox/RSF/DeepHit prior art remains.

priors.question: ¿Existe una cohorte humana independiente con duración y formación de relaciones que permita una falsación del módulo ESBM de ruptura sin confundir reciprocidad con pareja estable?
priors.rationale: HCMST 2017–2022 es un panel original de Stanford con preguntas de cómo se conocen las parejas y seguimiento 2020/2022, pero el archivo no ha sido descargado; sin esquema real no puede calibrarse ni estimarse la hazard. pairfam (Alemania) añade otra cohorte longitudinal independiente y respuestas del miembro de la pareja, pero sigue sin acceso a filas ni estimación. Stanford explicita cuestionario de relaciones a sujetos con pareja vigente (2862) y sin actual pero con pareja anterior (541), cambiando el riesgo de excluir automáticamente historias de ruptura; no se ha examinado su distribución por ola. The FReDA/pairfam Campus Use File is explicitly limited to teaching and is a reduced subset of the SUF; GESIS instructs scientific publications to use an appropriately licensed SUF rather than CUF. This source is same pairfam panel, not independent. Diverse Data Hub HCMST 2022 derived CSV has 1,328 observations, 21 relationship quality/duration/behavior variables; it is a cross-sectional reduced version of the existing 2017–2022 cohort, not a fresh follow-up sample and not a complete survival risk set. CSV data were not fetched; no hazard/censoring constructed. New original HCMST 2009 baseline was an independent cohort (4002 adults, 3009 partnered) with followups in 2010/2011/2013/2015, covering baseline relationship status and subsequent breakup. It is legitimately distinct from the 2017–2022 HCMST sample, even though archived by the same project/investigators. But no raw rows, codebook or original wave files are accessible in this turn, so no censoring, attrition, interval risks or hazard estimable. The original followup design conditions on having a baseline romantic partner; it tests conditional stability of existing unions, not unconditional formation from all singles. Stanford original HCMST 2009 (not 2017 fresh cohort) has a 2017 wave6 supplement that is NOT covered by ICPSR30103 5-wave public collection. Original codebook of waves1-3 v3.04 identifies qflag, w2_broke_up vs w3_brokeup_actual, death vs breakup and w3_xpartnered with 289 no longer eligible after 2010 breakup, proving followup risk sets are conditional and cannot be coded non-respondents as stable. Full raw wave 6 not accessed, so do not set time-to-event without supplementary files, weights and exposure/censoring codes. Additional 2019 GitHub gist displays CSV mirror inventory for all HCMST2009 baseline+wave4+wave5+wave6, with baseline header matching known weight/relationship breakup variables, but neither CSV nor archive bytes were actually recovered, validated against Stanford checksum or joined. This is NOT new cohort access, nor a research-ready source; no change to eligibility. Direct original Stanford distribution and its data-use agreement remain authoritative. New source SRC073 includes three authentic-format Stata binary supplements (public third-party GitHub repository) actually decoded and checksummed in this turn: W4 352532 bytes/N4002/K62, W5 525330/N4002/K78, W6 93480/N640/K77, with qflag-independent w4/w5 eligibility and breakup variable names and w6 breakup/death/online dating fields. The baseline v3.04 DTA is indexed with Git blob matching two third-party repositories but GitHub connector returns no bytes, and no official Stanford checksum or complete original panel reconstructed. This advances raw access to supplements, not the legal/reproducible eligibility of a full longitudinal inference: W6 N640 must not be treated as sample-survival ratio. Mixmosa gate: Mixmosa observed bilateral post-date interest, not actual durable unions, breakup times or censoring. Cannot transport immediate interest to long-term stability; require independent longitudinal follow-up and validated rights.
priors.uncertainty: Cohorte fuente validada documentalmente; acceso, pesos completos, definiciones de ruptura y seguimiento pendiente de inspección.

Source publication Su & Hu 2019 defines rec as candidate recommended/shown at homepage; click as opening target profile and msg as internal message. Original SSJY raw train.txt has identical action labels and actor-target-ROUND records but size differs, so identical extraction/platform not proved. Absence of click still not explicit rejection. Original 2011 contest announcement plus contemporary participant technical report describe Jiayuan A→B rec (photo appears in recommended position), click (opens detailed profile), msg (in-platform mail), and within-A sequential ROUND. Independent historical teaching slide transcript matches precisely 8,599,012, 8,366,058 rec, 184,291 click, 48,663 msg and 59,921 users to author-released SSJY ZIP. Strongly identifies exact historical contest line, not direct audit of current server, whether each rec was rendered or actually viewed, and not evidence of bilateral acceptance.

priors.question: Within real recorded recommendation sets, is target-specific propensity to be clicked predictive for previously unseen actors beyond a common incidence and coarse target-exposure/round groups?
priors.rationale: Original SSJY data have ~8.37 million recorded rec offers with ROUND; unique candidate click attached in same round 1.9807%. No random assignment, no actual attended impression, no explicit rejection or mutually formed union. Similar click/rec predictors were previously published (Su & Hu 2019). Descriptive repeated rec first click 2.491% vs later 1.277% is not a causal effect. The 2011 original contest scored candidate ranking with NDCG@10 using action grades rec=0, click=1, msg=2. Contemporary contestant reports weighted popularity voting and profile content baselines before 2020 MotifGNN and long before ESBM. N82 compares within-cohort logloss but not published NDCG@10 or these original strong popularity/content baselines. A contemporary participant asserts rights of publication require company authorization; rightsholder current terms not verified. Do not cite N82 as publication-authorized original result. Original contest's complete 2011 benchmark required train.txt, test.txt, profile_m.txt and profile_f.txt (34 attributes for each user). Recovered MotifGNN ZIP contains train.txt, profile_m.txt and generated balanced train/test CSVs, but NOT original test.txt or profile_f.txt; hence exact historical NDCG@10 competitor cannot be reproduced from this recovered archive alone. Its artificial 50:50 train/test generated subsets are not the contest's NDCG@10 test. No data rows reprocessed to establish this: only source inventory and original 2012 documentation.

Bootstrap covers heldout actor clustering only, not source/platform shifts. Posthoc baseline not new preregistered test.
